formattedAddress: 114, Taiwan, Taipei City, Neihu District, Baohu Village, Section 6, Minquan E Rd, 200號1樓

text.text: Absolutely amazing! From the creativity of the chef to the execution and cook of every ingredient, this has been one of the best dining experiences ever! I've dined in Michelin star restaurants all over the world. But this humble restaurant is a diamond in the rough! The chef seems to take apart every famous dish and put them back together differently, his way. And his way works! It's just an amazing experience from a crazy good chef!
